### CVE-2012-0663
- Assigner: apple | Published: 2012-05-16 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 19433: Apple QuickTime - TeXML Stack Buffer Overflow (Metasploit) (local/windows, 2012-06-28, verified=1)
